errors.evidence: The description states that the years on the horizontal axis are arranged in alphabetical order, but they are arranged in chronological order (2014, 2015, 2016...).

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по хоризонталната ос в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of the error that the bars are arranged in alphabetical order. The sentence is also self-contradictory, as it correctly adds that the years increase from left to right, which is chronological, not alphabetical.

The prompt asks to include representative values for the highest and lowest bars. The description fails to mention the peak yield in 2015 (approx. 260,000 tonnes) and the lowest yield in 2014 (approx. 130,000 tonnes).
